sources.title: Advanced setup
sources.locator: System requirements
sources.finding: CLI runs on macOS 13+, Windows 10 1809+/Server 2019+, Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 10+, Alpine 3.19+; 4 GB+ RAM; x64 or ARM64; internet required; Bash, Zsh, PowerShell or CMD.

sources.title: Authentication
sources.locator: Log in to Claude Code; Log in with multiple accounts
sources.finding: Account types: Claude Pro/Max, Teams/Enterprise, Claude Console, Bedrock/Vertex(Agent Platform)/Foundry, Claude apps gateway. Multiple accounts via separate CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR directories. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY approval skips login.

sources.title: Claude Code on mobile
sources.locator: Work from your phone; Get push notifications; Limitations
sources.finding: The Claude iOS/Android app is a client for cloud sessions, projects, Remote Control and Dispatch (no code runs on the phone). Push notifications when Remote Control is active; local-only commands such as /plugin and /resume do not work; Bypass permissions cannot be selected from the app.

sources.title: Remote Control
sources.locator: Requirements; Start a Remote Control session; Limitations; Connection and security
sources.finding: Drive a local CLI/Desktop/VS Code session from claude.ai/code or the mobile app; machine must stay on; Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise only (no API keys, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, gateways); server mode default capacity 32; transcript stored on Anthropic servers while connected.

sources.title: Desktop application
sources.locator: Sessions; Choose a permission mode; Work in parallel; Dispatch; Coming from the CLI
sources.finding: Desktop Code tab has parallel sessions with Git isolation, diff review and comments, app preview, integrated terminal, permission modes, scheduled tasks and Dispatch from phone; needs a paid subscription; Desktop does not accept a Console API key directly.

sources.locator: Requirements; Permission modes; Git integration

sources.title: JetBrains IDEs

sources.finding: Plugin runs the separately installed claude CLI in the IDE terminal and adds diff viewing, selection and diagnostic sharing; it does not bundle the CLI.

sources.title: Use Claude Code in the cloud
sources.locator: Plans; GitHub authentication options; Environment expired; Limitations; Share sessions; Auto-fix pull requests
sources.finding: Cloud sessions on Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise (premium seats); Anthropic-managed VM by default; clone/PR creation requires GitHub (GHES for Team/Enterprise); non-GitHub repos via local bundle <100 MB; idle sessions pause and VMs are reclaimed, conversation history restored on reopen; shared rate limits, no separate compute charge; CLI --cloud and --teleport (one-way cloud to terminal); auto-fix of PR CI failures and review comments needs the Claude GitHub App.

sources.title: Configure cloud environments
sources.locator: Installed tools; Time limits; Setup scripts; Environment caching; Network access
sources.finding: Anthropic-hosted sessions use fresh Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 VMs with approximate ceilings of 4 vCPUs, 16 GB RAM and 30 GB disk. Setup under roughly five minutes is cached as a filesystem snapshot, expiring after roughly seven days. Foreground Bash defaults to two minutes, up to ten; timed-out commands move to background except sleep-prefixed commands. Unattended background commands have a separate time limit. Idle VMs pause and can be reclaimed. Network secrets are available on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise, with role/configuration requirements.

sources.title: Self-hosted environments
sources.locator: How self-hosted environments work; Availability and limitations
sources.finding: Public beta on Team and Enterprise (off by default); runners on customer infrastructure execute cloud sessions; unavailable with ZDR or HIPAA; model inference still via Anthropic API unless Bedrock/Agent Platform configured; session content goes to Anthropic.

sources.title: Automate work with routines
sources.locator: Triggers; Add an API trigger; GitHub event; Usage and limits
sources.finding: Cloud routines are now named cloud scheduled tasks; shared web/Desktop/CLI account records, schedule/API/GitHub triggers, research preview fire endpoint, and per-account execution. /schedule creates them and /routines remains an alias.

sources.title: Run prompts on a schedule
sources.locator: Compare scheduling options; Seven-day expiry; Limitations
sources.finding: /loop and cron tools are session-scoped (1 minute minimum, recurring tasks expire after 7 days, only fire while Claude Code is running and idle, no catch-up for missed fires); cloud routines minimum 1 hour; Desktop tasks need machine on.

sources.title: Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Code Desktop
sources.locator: Overview; Compare scheduling options
sources.finding: Local Desktop scheduled tasks run on the user machine and fire only while the app is open and the computer is awake; remote routines run in the cloud.

sources.title: Data usage
sources.locator: Data training policy; Data retention; Telemetry services; Default behaviors by API provider
sources.finding: Current data policy states opt-in consumer training and five-year versus thirty-day retention by choice; commercial no training by default and thirty-day standard retention. Local plaintext CLI transcripts default to thirty days, with Desktop/Cowork exemptions. Metrics and error reports have separate opt-outs. Error reports default on for direct Claude API Pro, Max and Ultra sign-ins on v2.1.198+, otherwise off. Provider-managed-host metrics are an explicit exception to third-party-provider default-off behavior.

sources.finding: The --worktree or -w flag starts a session in a separate Git working directory, by default .claude/worktrees/<name>, on a new worktree-<name> branch. Subagents can use isolation: worktree. Worktrees share repository history and Git metadata; this documents file separation, not a security sandbox. Source check only; no session was run.
